data.raw_text:
SM malls in Davao City are the latest to start charging for parking, as more malls in the region resort to parking fees to free up suspiciously congested lots.

SM City Davao and SM Lanang Premier will charge a ₱20 flat rate for both cars and motorcycles beginning March 2. Fees in SM malls across the country vary greatly per region; most urban locations charge by the hour, while some provincial branches waive fees altogether.

Parking in most private establishments across Davao City was free-of-charge as mandated by a city ordinance. But in late 2025, some local malls began charging fees amid concerns of car congestion. The city government is similarly cracking down on illegal street parkers beginning this year.

Most netizens praised the move by SM, reporting that parking was often full even if the malls were not crowded—raising suspicion that spots were occupied by customers of neighboring businesses and shops.

However, some suggested that this was merely a band-aid solution to the city’s growing traffic and congestion issues. Davao City was ranked as the most congested city in the Philippines in the 2025 TomTom Traffic Index. With ramped up commercial activity and property development in the region, the introduction of new fees is a wake-up call for authorities to take meaningful action to improve mobility.

Report by Kiara Gorrospe

#radarPHBusiness #radarPH
